params.prompt: Cinematic photo-real image, square 1:1, dark warm moody interior (background #0B0907 tones), a small group strategy session: the man from the reference photo (same face, blond hair, short beard, black t-shirt) sits at a round dark table leading a discussion with four participants (two women, two men, 30–50 years old, diverse, casual), seen from slightly above and to the side. On the table: laptops, notebooks, a few bright yellow (#FDD506) sticky notes, a coffee cup; a single warm pendant lamp above casts golden light on faces; the rest of the room falls into deep dark shadow with subtle yellow rim light.
